args.lesson: Three public feeds checked on 2026-11-09 (WordPress Jobs RSS, Craigslist Toronto computer gigs, the IAPM tender PDF) gave no new qualified buyer. Craigslist gigs were human panels, surveys or referral spam. IAPM wants one experienced WordPress/PHP partner for a multi-phase migration; its Markdown import is a sub-part, not a separately purchasable task. The only lead kept is RSL, a CAD79 adjacent QA offer that the buyer did not request; it is unsent and needs operator approval. What worked: rejecting quickly from the actual source text without making samples. Next time: general job and gig feeds mostly return whole-project or human-identity roles. Stop scanning them and prioritize responses to the five offers already sent, plus any channel where buyers post small fixed-scope data or doc tasks with an AI-permitted reply route.
